gloss: to suction; to draw in; to attract

definitions.gloss: to suction; to draw in; to vacuum up
definitions.explanation: To pull in a substance (air, liquid, dust, etc.) by creating a vacuum or negative pressure.

definitions.gloss: to attract; to draw in (people, attention)
definitions.explanation: To powerfully attract people, interest, or attention.

notes:
{吸|きゅう} (inhale, suck) + {引|いん} (pull, draw). The physical sense involves mechanically drawing in substances, while the figurative sense describes powerful attraction of people or resources.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吸引力|きゅういんりょく} — suction power; drawing power
- ⟦{吸引|きゅういん}→吸引：24162_kyuuin⟧⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧ — suction device
- ⟦{痰|たん}→痰：17896_tan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{吸引|きゅういん}→吸引：24162_kyuuin⟧ — phlegm suctioning (medical)
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{吸引|きゅういん}する — attract population

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吸|す}い{込|こ}む→吸い込む：06984_suikomu⟧ — to suck in; to inhale — more everyday and physical
- {引|ひ}きつける — to attract; to draw — more common for figurative attraction
- ⟦{魅了|みりょう}する→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧ — to fascinate; to charm — focuses on emotional appeal
